item.description:
### Added - Settings: a fuller Updates card — your current version and the latest one, an inline progress bar while a check runs, the last check time, and a highlighted card when a new version is out - The update strip along the top of the window is taller and shows its version — “Pulse X.X is available — click to update” — so it's obvious what it means
### Changed - Thermal: the throttle word (nominal / slowed / throttled) is now colored by the actual SMC throttle level — nominal reads neutral instead of red
### Fixed - Updates: the scheduled hourly check now actually runs — it silently stopped after the Sparkle 2 migration, so new releases went unnoticed until you checked manually - Settings: “Check for Updates” no longer pops a pointless “you're up to date” dialog, shows a clear error when a check fails, and keeps up-to-date text out of its “New update available” card - The update card in Settings now says “up to date” correctly and folds its progress slot away when idle
